title: Discriminating ferrotoroidic from antiferrotoroidic ground states using a 3d quantum spin sensor

material_class.structural_family: {Dy3Cr(OH)4} distorted cubane / Dy3 triangle building block

synthesis.procedure: CrCl3·6H2O (0.016 g, 0.1 mmol) was gently heated in acetonitrile to give a purple solution. Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (0.22 g, 0.5 mmol) and isonicotinic acid (0.12 g, 1 mmol) were then added. Triethylamine (0.4 mL, 0.3 mmol) was added dropwise to give a blue/green solution, and the reaction was stirred for 2–4 h at 70 °C. The solvent was removed, the resulting oil was redissolved in methanol, and layering with diethyl ether afforded pale purple/pink single crystals within 3–4 days.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction with gentle heating, then solvent-layering crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: solvent removed; oil redissolved in methanol and layered with diethyl ether to grow pale purple/pink single crystals

properties.summary: Tetranuclear CrDy3 cluster with a ground-state Dy3 toroidal (vortex) configuration. Room-temperature χmT matches three uncoupled DyIII plus CrIII (S = 3/2). Powder isothermal magnetization and μ-SQUID single-crystal magnetization show an atypical sickle-shaped hysteresis; modelling attributes the weak-field response to coupling of the CrIII spin to remnant magnetization of the Dy3 toroid.
